text:
Maya R: FYI: Node sampleapp is intermittently failing against /rerank when batching helper + auth-retry both trigger. Getting 400s: embedding.length mismatch.
Devon S: repro?
Maya R: We batch 5-9 vectors. When an auth refresh causes a retry, the request uses a TypedArray.subarray that some other code mutates, so one vector becomes 1535 instead of 1536. API returns 400.
Luis G: sounds like view vs copy bug. Python client builds lists so doesn't hit it. Which Node SDK?
Maya R: node-sdk 0.9.2 in sampleapp. snippet: 
```
const batches = chunk(vecs, 8)
await Promise.all(batches.map(b => sendBatch(b)))
// sendBatch may enqueue original body for retry
```
Devon S: quick mitigation: make retry path clone req body before re-enqueue.
Luis G: agreed. Medium fix: retry middleware should deep-clone bodies or mark immutable. Long term: add SDK lint rule.
Platform APIs: Can we make error payload more actionable? Current message is terse. If we add "batch_index" and "expected_dim"/"got_dim" fields that would speed debugging. We'll keep backward compatibility.
Maya R: pushed small fix to sampleapp that copies buffers before enqueue. CI green. Will follow up with an E2E test that simulates 401->retry while batching.
CI Bot: sampleapp PR pipeline passed ✅
Devon S: action list: 1) hotfix copy-before-enqueue, 2) update retry middleware, 3) API error envelope change (coord w/ Platform APIs), 4) add node+py parity E2E for batching+retry.
Maya R: added note in onboarding README: avoid reusing subarray for request bodies; clone if you'll retry.
Luis G: I'll file an internal ticket to track SDK parity and the lint rule.
